brief: Start in a guarded control room with no keys required for the shortest exit route. Push through corridors and storage into a central hub with multiple exits, then an armory and final chamber. Exit is at the end of a long corridor behind a large door. Blue and red keycards exist off the critical path for optional / locked side areas.
landmarks: large door at end of final corridor
pacing_notes: Steady combat along a mostly linear spine; side keys are optional pressure, not mandatory gating.

rubric_hints.navigation: Hub is the main landmark; keep the exit corridor visually distinct.
rubric_hints.pacing: Quiet-ish start room, denser fights toward the final chamber.
rubric_hints.mechanics: Optional blue/red cards off-path; critical path can stay keyless.
rubric_hints.affordances: Military doors and keycard colors stay consistent.
rubric_hints.narrative: Occupied base: storage and armory read as lived-in spaces.
